idea-plugin.name: FactoryLine AI Proof
idea-plugin.description:
Review AI changes with evidence in view

FactoryLine connects code changes, audit findings, tests, and repair candidates to local, source-bound receipts.

What's improved in 1.3.6

Pair the JetBrains, VS Code, and Open VSX adapters with the separately installed Code Factory CLI 0.50.0: 30 native security rules across 12 languages through configured external workers. Analyzers are not bundled in this plugin.

Measured default-tier precision: 90% (54 TP / 6 FP / 0 unclear; 60 alerts; Wilson 95% 79.9–95.3%). The completed panel used AI labels, six observed languages and 15 shortfall fills—not twelve-language precision, review-tier precision, recall or independent human validation.

Review source-bound claim verification and bounded Proof Agent evidence, with optional SARIF and pre-commit outputs and read-only mutation-diff inspection. Verification binds an observation; it does not prove code correctness or release readiness.

IDE receipt reads fail closed for stale, malformed, oversized, escaped, or changing files. Junie is optional and human-controlled.

Start in your repository

Run factory guide, then factory scan --root .. Use Graph Ops to inspect evidence and choose the next action.

FactoryLine is free. Optional paid features are not active in this Marketplace build. Use Tools | FactoryLine | Run First Proof for a local setup demonstration, not a repository assessment. The plugin does not upload project source or receipts.

The plugin uses your separately configured local FactoryLine runtime. Junie is optional. You control applying changes, merging, and publishing. Checks are bounded and do not certify a repository.

Documentation | Report an issue
